component.name: CardVertical
component.description: A course card with the image on top and the title, progress and metadata below, optionally with a favorite or overflow action.

useWhen: Course cards in a horizontal carousel, such as the Discover and Saved courses sections.
The learner has started the course: pass progress, and a ProgressBar shows under the image.
The learner has finished the course: progress of 100 or more adds a Completed marker, and the bar stays.
The learner can save the course (action Favorite) or has several course actions (action Menu).
The card opens the course page: pass href. Omit it only when something else on the page opens the course.
The preset can't show the content, such as an instructor row or custom meta: compose the parts from a pattern.

notFor.because: The serif title and course metadata row are designed for course items specifically.
notFor.note: Use Card with a custom inner layout for other content types.

notFor.case: A course card on an inverted (dark) section, such as the footer
notFor.because: CardVertical has no inverted variant; its text colors assume a light or elevated surface.

useWhen.lg: Feature carousels and Discover sections, where image impact matters. Portrait thumbnail (4/5).
useWhen.sm: Compact carousels or narrower slots. Landscape thumbnail (3/2).

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The article container. Provides size and the title id to every part through context; owns the spacing between Media, Progress and Body and draws them in that order whatever their source order. Write Body first, then Progress, then Media, so the title leads the reading order.

parts.name: Media
parts.description: Positioned wrapper around Image (aspect 4/5 for lg, 3/2 for sm, from Root's size). Props: src, alt (''), and an optional single Action child (runtime guard throws otherwise — fixed, not slot, because the overlay is optional). No overflow clipping so the Menu panel can extend past it.

parts.name: Action
parts.description: Top-right overlay slot on Media. Exactly one Favorite or Menu; throws otherwise. Maps to the Figma 'Action' instance-swap property.

parts.name: Favorite
parts.description: Round transparent heart Button with an on-media halo toggling aria-pressed. Props: pressed, defaultPressed (false), onPressedChange.

parts.name: Menu
parts.description: Round transparent kebab Button with an on-media halo that opens a DropdownMenu. Props: items (DropdownMenuItem[]), onSelect. Open state is internal (Figma 'Expanded' is design-only).

parts.name: Body
parts.description: Stack gap=sm holding Title and the card's text content. Children only — no layout props.

parts.name: Title
parts.description: Heading (headline-serif, subheader size) that registers the title id. Props: as ('h3'), children. Must come first in Body.

parts.name: Meta
parts.description: Inline gap=sm wrap align=center for the metadata row. Children only — nest an Inline to group items more tightly.

parts.name: Completed
parts.description: check Icon (color.icon.subtle) + 'Completed' Text, same styling as Certified. No props. The preset renders it when progress >= 100.

donts.case: Writing CardVertical.Media (or Progress) before CardVertical.Body in a parts composition
donts.because: Root draws the image on top whatever the source order, so the card looks the same, but a screen reader then hears the image, the Save button and the bar before the title, and skimming by heading lands mid-card.
donts.instead: Write Body first, then Progress, then Media, as the preset does.

donts.case: Adding gap or margin to a part (e.g. <CardVertical.Body gap="lg">, or a margin on content inside Body)
donts.because: Parts own the card's rhythm (ADR-023): open parts accept children only, so a layout prop is a TypeScript error, and a margin breaks the shared vertical rhythm.
donts.instead: Nest a Stack or Inline inside the open part for custom spacing.

donts.case: Wrapping CardVertical.Root (or the preset) in an <a>
donts.because: The Favorite/Menu buttons would become interactive content nested inside a link, which is invalid and confuses keyboard and screen-reader users.
donts.instead: Pass href (preset) or Title href (parts): the card links through its title and the link covers the card, with Action on top.

donts.case: Using Heading instead of CardVertical.Title inside CardVertical.Body, omitting Title from a parts composition, or rendering two Titles
donts.because: Title registers the id that names the Favorite/Menu buttons; a plain Heading leaves them unnamed and loses the card's serif size override. Nothing checks for Title at runtime: without it every aria-labelledby on the card points at a missing id and the buttons read only 'Save' / 'More options'; two Titles duplicate the id. `required` is enforced by layout:validate only.
donts.instead: Always render exactly one CardVertical.Title as the first child of CardVertical.Body (set its `as` for the page outline).

donts.case: Putting anything other than a single CardVertical.Action inside CardVertical.Media (e.g. a Badge, text or a second overlay button)
donts.because: Media is a fixed part whose only optional child is the Action overlay; it throws on anything else. The overlay corner is sized and positioned for one round icon button.
donts.instead: Put extra content in CardVertical.Body/Meta; put a second action into CardVertical.Menu's items.

donts.case: Using a Badge to signal completion
donts.because: Completion is derived from progress (ADR-025); a separate badge can disagree with the bar (Completed with progress=40).
donts.instead: Pass progress={100}. Only in a parts composition render <CardVertical.Completed /> inside CardVertical.Meta.

donts.case: A parts composition at progress >= 100 without CardVertical.Completed
donts.because: The preset adds the Completed marker from progress; a parts composition doesn't derive it.

patterns.name: favorite-saved
patterns.useWhen: A course card the learner can save or unsave in place.

patterns.name: overflow-menu
patterns.useWhen: A course card has several secondary actions (share, remove, mark complete) that don't fit as buttons.

patterns.name: custom-meta
patterns.useWhen: A card's meta row shows something other than duration and certified status.

patterns.name: instructor-row
patterns.useWhen: A card shows who teaches the course, between the title and the meta row.

patterns.name: grouped-meta
patterns.useWhen: A card's meta row pairs a badge with a related value that reads as one item (New and a date).

patterns.name: card-carousel
patterns.useWhen: A row of course cards wider than the viewport, paged with arrows (Discover, Saved courses).
